description: gramatr guards: secret-guard + injection-guard + pii-guard, wired as one combined PostToolUse hook on Bash (see combined-hook.sh for why ONE hook, not three — Claude Code's own docs say multiple hooks returning updatedToolOutput for the same call have undefined resolution order). SessionStart runs a self-heal script (same idempotent-check pattern as grāmatr's own statusline-selfheal.js) that installs/starts the injection-guard and pii-guard daemons if they're not already running.
